scenarios.name: bot.next() moves to next action
scenarios.steps:
Given Bot is at clarify action
When bot.next() is called
Then Bot moves to strategy (next action in workflow)

scenarios.name: bot.next() progresses through workflow sequence
scenarios.steps:
Given Bot is at first action
When bot.next() is called multiple times
Then Bot progresses through clarify -> strategy -> build -> validate -> render

scenarios.name: bot.next() at final action advances to next behavior
scenarios.steps:
Given Bot is at render (final action of shape)
When bot.next() is called
Then Bot advances to next behavior (discovery) first action (clarify)

scenarios.name: bot.current() returns current action instructions
scenarios.steps:
Given Bot is at a specific action
When bot.current() is called
Then Current action instructions object is returned

scenarios.name: bot.next() respects behavior.json workflow sequence
scenarios.steps:
Given Bot is at strategy (second action)
When bot.next() is called
Then Bot moves to build (third action), following behavior.json order

scenarios.name: bot.next() with no behavior selected starts workflow
scenarios.steps:
Given No behavior is selected
When bot.next() is called
Then Bot starts at first behavior (shape), first action (clarify)
Then NOTE: Currently bot.next() returns an error when no behavior is selected.
Then This test documents the DESIRED behavior - bot should be smart enough
Then to start at the beginning of the workflow automatically.

scenarios.name: Can navigate to a specific behavior
scenarios.steps:
Given Bot exists with multiple behaviors
When behaviors.navigate_to('discovery') called
Then Current behavior is set to discovery

scenarios.name: Next behavior in sequence can be retrieved
scenarios.steps:
Given Bot is at scenarios behavior
When behaviors.next() called
Then Returns next behavior (tests) with complete structure

scenarios.name: Getting next behavior returns None when at last behavior
scenarios.steps:
Given Bot is at last behavior in list
When behaviors.next() called
Then Returns None

scenarios.name: Can navigate to a specific action
scenarios.steps:
Given Bot is at a behavior with multiple actions
When actions.navigate_to('build') called
Then Current action is set to build

scenarios.name: Next action in sequence can be retrieved
scenarios.steps:
Given Bot is at clarify action (first action)
When actions.next() called
Then Returns strategy action (second action)

scenarios.name: Getting next action returns None when at last action
scenarios.steps:
Given Bot is at last action in behavior
When actions.next() called
Then Returns None

scenarios.name: Navigate sets current behavior and first action
scenarios.steps:
GIVEN: Bot has behaviors configured
WHEN: bot.behaviors.navigate_to('shape') is called
THEN: bot.behaviors.current.name == 'shape'
AND: bot.behaviors.current.actions.current_action_name == 'clarify'

scenarios.name: User navigates with behavior only (no dots)
scenarios.steps:
GIVEN: CLI is at shape.clarify.instructions
WHEN: user enters 'discovery'
THEN: CLI navigates to discovery.clarify (first action)

scenarios.name: User navigates with behavior.action (one dot)
scenarios.steps:
GIVEN: CLI is at shape.clarify.instructions
WHEN: user enters 'discovery.build'
THEN: CLI navigates to discovery.build.instructions

scenarios.name: User navigates with behavior.action.operation (two dots)
scenarios.steps:
GIVEN: CLI is at shape.clarify.instructions
WHEN: user enters 'discovery.build.instructions'
THEN: CLI executes discovery.build.instructions

scenarios.name: User enters invalid behavior in dot notation
scenarios.steps:
GIVEN: CLI is at shape.clarify.instructions
WHEN: user enters 'invalid_behavior.build.instructions'
THEN: CLI displays error message

scenarios.name: User navigates with next command
scenarios.steps:
GIVEN: CLI is at shape.clarify.instructions
WHEN: user enters 'next'
THEN: CLI navigates to shape.strategy

scenarios.name: User navigates with back command
scenarios.steps:
GIVEN: CLI is at shape.strategy.instructions
WHEN: user enters 'back'
THEN: CLI navigates to shape.clarify

Given Panel displays behavior hierarchy

When User clicks on discovery.build action link

Given Bot is at shape.clarify
When User clicks next button
Then Bot navigates to shape.strategy

Given Bot is at shape.strategy
When User clicks back button

Given Bot is at last action of last behavior
When User views next button
Then Next button is disabled
